tcc_identity_binding.note: macOS TCC grants are identity-bound. Screen Recording, Accessibility, and Microphone authorization must match this exact installed app bundle identifier, canonical designated requirement/signing leaf, stable /Applications path, and source provenance. A rebuilt, re-signed, moved, or ad-hoc Host can be treated by macOS as a different app and must stay blocked until the read-only rows prove authorization for that exact identity.
